title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ps69: SosResource.render_post ignores cancel type
description:
spec/12-apps.md §18.4.3 defines `"type": "cancel"` to cancel a previous SOS alert (line 602). However, `SosResource.render_post()` (resources.py:727) always calls `self.activate()` regardless of type — even for cancel. The type field check at L727-728 just passes through for non-"sos" types instead of routing to `self.cancel()` for the cancel type.

Additionally, the module docstring at L27 says "PUT activates SOS" but the implementation uses POST — a minor documentation inconsistency.

Repro: POST /sos with `{"type":"cancel","node":"0000000000000000","ts":1}` — should cancel but activates instead.
close_reason: Cancel routing already implemented at HEAD: render_post (emergency.py:213-214) routes type==cancel to _cancel_from_body (:277-308) which authorizes with parity to render_delete (active-check 4.04, envelope parse 4.01, pubkey->active-IID binding, verify_sos_origin over canonical core, strictly-advancing sequence gate + accept, then cancel() + updated_state() notify). Verified on heft: 178/178 SOS tests pass (test_sos_resource.py incl. test_post_cancel_cancels_sos - the bead's exact repro - plus idle->4.04 and non-originator->4.01). 3x codereview (correctness/security/robustness, reviewer-model passes): spec 18.4.2/18.4.3 conformance PASS, DELETE parity PASS, replay-gate semantics PASS, no new P0-P2. Two new P3 findings filed (cancel-path rate limiting vs spec 18.4.1; tracker LRU-eviction replay amplifier as child of 2m0f). All 8 pre-existing child beads re-verified as still accurate and open (nsi9/2m0f/5w4q/kw4o/ikcx/8umh/snh1/zb3w).
